procedure_steps.instruction: Use 0.1 g solid OR 4-5 drops liquid in 2 mL water; add dioxane dropwise only if needed for homogeneity. Add 2 mL 5% NaOH, then iodine/KI reagent to a persistent dark colour. Follow source heating/endpoint sequence; remove excess iodine with a few drops NaOH, dilute with an equal volume of water and stand 10-15 minutes.
procedure_steps.observation: Yellow iodoform precipitate is conditional on the analyte. Equal-volume dilution is relative to the current mixture, not a guessed fixed mL dose.

quantities.note: Persistent iodine endpoint; no fixed amount.
